excluded.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > should not try to clear an undefined timeout when exiting source state of a delayed transition
excluded.reason: what it asserts is the clock: XState's actor-system scheduler must not call the clock's clearTimeout when the exit of the source state cancels a delayed event that has already fired (a custom clock option with a clearTimeout spy, and a real sleep); core cases run the pure functions with the oracle's own scheduler, and no record holds a call to the clock, while the value it also checks (the target after the delay) is what "transition after delay through yellow" shows. It would need a record of the clock's clearTimeout calls, which neither oracle writes
